sn27.9:1.2: yo bhikkhave, paṭhavīdhātuyā chandarāgo, cittasse’so upakkileso.
sn27.9:1.8: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti, nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti.
sn27.9:1.9: nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati, abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti.
